rationale: Amended after validation pass (2026-05-19): P0 BLOCKER (R-001) coverage at unit level is 100% (2 unit tests pass and directly assert the BLOCKER scenario); however the planned defense-in-depth integration test T-R001-INT-001 (TenantIndex_RealDaprBackedConflictThenSuccess_PreservesIndexAsync in ProjectionWriteConformanceIntegrationTests.cs) was never implemented — the file does not exist on disk. Overall coverage is 95% (39/41 in-scope FULL), and P1 coverage is ~91% (>=90% target). Formal priority-threshold logic on a risk-coverage basis still yields PASS. The CONCERNS verdict is driven by THREE test-design Exit Criteria gaps: (1) CI guard T-R012-CI-001 (EventStore submodule pointer drift) not implemented in .github/workflows/{ci,release}.yml; (2) the planned T-R001-INT-001 integration tier never built (REC-1B); (3) two PARTIAL items (Story 10.2 AC#9 and Story 10.3B AC#7) leave the R-007 negative-content sentinel gates incomplete on the audit-key and cancellation-failure paths. Decision: CONCERNS — proceed with caution; address REC-1 (CI guard) before closing the epic, decide on REC-1B (build T-R001-INT-001 or formally waive the integration tier in a sprint-change-proposal), and ship REC-2 + REC-3 (sentinel analogs) as follow-up patches.
